reviewer: AI assistant visual review; not human certification
scope: Eight randomly selected train/validation crops per target class (64 total), plus 40 randomly selected box-exclusion background crops. Seed 42. No test image review or predictions.
findings: Sampled crops match the upstream balloon colors and goal color/shape labels. Real indoor arena, reflective foil balloons, netted goals, motion blur and oblique views. Sampled backgrounds show walls, ceiling, machinery and partial colored structures, with no obvious complete target.
decision: Proceed with a research teacher baseline using upstream labels; no full annotation completeness claim.
limitations: Not every image or box was visually reviewed.
Ambiguous generic Balloons excluded as positives; their boxes still exclude backgrounds.
Clip groups and time blocks inferred from filenames; independence of recording sessions is not established.
No full-frame proposal, Pi-camera, tracking or flight qualification.
